The **Pipe Wrench** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The Pipe Wrench is a heavy metal wrench, speckled with rust and covered in chipped red paint.

When customizing the pipe wrench, there are both entries for appearance, using the valorous Alistair skin and the samurai sword skin, and customization, using the heart wrencher skin. This can lead to the pipe wrench being named "Valorous Alistair Heart Wrencher" or "Samurai Heart Wrencher", respectively. The heart wrencher skin will always overwrite the other two skins, no matter the order they were applied.
